title: Why Cities Need Shady Streets
author: 苏打阅读编辑部
introZh: 从街道树荫看城市规划如何影响行人的日常生活。
paragraphs: On a hot afternoon, a dark road can hold heat long after the sun has moved away. People walking beside it may feel much warmer than people in a nearby park. This difference is not only a matter of comfort. It can decide whether people choose to walk at all.

Trees can help because their leaves block some sunlight before it reaches the road. They also release small amounts of water through their leaves, and this process can cool the air around them. However, planting a tree does not solve every problem. A young tree needs water and care before it can give useful shade.

For this reason, a useful street plan must include both planting and long-term care. Residents can help choose places where shade is most needed, such as bus stops and walking routes to schools. The goal is not simply to make a street look greener. The goal is to make everyday travel safer and more comfortable.
